summary: Mini games: Fun games offline classic pastimes like Hangman for the whole family
description: Have fun with the fantastic mini games pastimes of Tellmewow! A collection of entertainment offline mini games so you can have fun playing with words and numbers. Escape from boredom and exercise your brain while you enjoy and learn! This puzzle books includes Word Search, Hangman, Sudoku, Tic Tac Toe and Solitaire and many more! No wifi needed. In this compilation of classic games and mini games you will find various fun games to spend your free time and no wifi needed: ・ Word Search ・ Hangman ・ Tic-Tac-Toe ・ Sudoku ・ Solitaire ・ Dots and Boxes ・ SOS ・ 2048 ・ Minesweeper ・ Snake ・ Onet ・ Dominoes Your favorite classic games to play whenever and wherever you want without internet connection! Fun games for you & no wifi needed! Train your mind with these educational classic games and fun games where you can demonstrate your language skills and learn vocabulary in different languages. In addition, you will also find logic games and numbers to exercise your brain. Don't have Internet? Don't worry. No wifi is needed in this game DAILY CHALLENGE We dare you to complete the daily challenge of this classic games! Accept the challenge and win the different fun games that we select for you every day. Pass the daily challenge and win crowns to enjoy the different rewards. CHARACTERISTICS ・ Fun games with simple design and intuitive interface ・ Classic games: puzzle book and logic games ・ Mini games suitable for all ages ・ Thousands of words to enjoy playing ・ Great time killer ・ Available in 8 languages ・ Different levels and hints ・ Exercise your brain daily with this mini games ・ Constant updates with new games ・ No internet connection required ・ Different fun mini games included: Word Search, Hangman, Sudoku and Tic Tac Toe and many more! Do not think twice and discover all the fun classic games we have prepared in this special collection of our games. Mini games for hours and hours of fun & no wifi needed! ABOUT SENIOR GAMES - TELLMEWOW Senior Games is a project of Tellmewow, a mobile game development company specialized in easy adaptation and basic usability, which make our games ideal for older people or young people who simply want to play an occasional game without major complications. If you have any suggestions for improvement or want to stay informed about upcoming games that we are going to publish, follow us on our social networks: seniorgames_tmw
